why: Searches turned up only PrimeGrid's ongoing computational search (lower bound extended to roughly 1.8×10^19, i.e. past 2^64) and unrelated papers on k-Wall-Sun-Sun primes and Lucas sequence p-adic valuations; no proof, disproof, or new primality result answering the existence question, and an extended search bound does not resolve an infinitude/existence question.
